text:
At the centre is the field itself, unmarked, holding no line you can read until the light falls a certain way. What the low sun would show, if it came, is the true shape of a track — not the one you would prefer to have walked, but the one the ground actually took. Beneath the grass the prints have been there all along, pressed in and waiting on an angle of light no one arranges. Each was made by a weight set down long before, small at the time, and the soil kept them without being asked. Now the sun is moving low, and for the length of a breath the whole trail stands out clear across the field before the light shifts and the grass is only grass again. What was hidden was never hidden by design, Kuky — only by the hour. A single low sun, and the field you thought was blank is written from edge to edge.
✦ The empty rune is not silence — it is what has not yet been named. What would you call it, if you had to?

The wet rope had swollen around the knot before you reached it. Its coarse fibres had locked together, and pulling had only drawn them tighter. Now your hands meet the cost of pulling harder. You can see which strand bears the strain, though the knot is not yet loose. If you keep pulling, a loose end may show itself where the fibres shift. Your path may be a longer hold on what is fixed, or an opening through what you cannot yet see.
✦ What remains a matter of chance, even when you act with care?

jm: Single Uruz · myšlenka z runy · Opus
text:
Where the bog releases the bull, mud still hangs on its flanks and it walks on anyway. Uruz is strength that does not wait to be clean before it moves. The next step is taken half-covered, and the ground takes the weight all the same. What is already in you may be enough to carry you out, or enough to carry you further than out.
✦ What holds its shape without being tamed?
